lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice narrating a short past sequence with time markers and a simple result.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining why a practical task took longer than expected.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Retelling events in order and making the consequence clear.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss why an errand took longer than expected and what consequence it has for the rest of the day.

main_focus.name: past sequence with preteritum and time markers
main_focus.description: Use preteritum with först, sedan, efter det, and till slut to create a short connected narrative.
model_examples: Först väntade jag i kön, sedan pratade jag med personalen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use preteritum in a sequence naturally 5-6 times.

allowed_supporting_grammar: perfekt for present relevance if needed
simple result with så or därför

useful_chunks: Det tog längre tid än jag trodde.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical sequencing language that supports a short spoken recap.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person explains that an errand took longer than expected.
dialogue_shape.middle: They retell the sequence of events and identify the main delay.
dialogue_shape.ending: They connect the delay to the current plan and decide what to do next.

target_complexity.repetition: sequence markers should make the order easy to follow

focus: the order of events in the past sequence
how the delay affects the current plan

sentence_focus: one past sentence starting with först
one past sentence starting with sedan
one sentence explaining that something took longer than expected
one sentence connecting the past delay to being late now
